Subject: Pre-purchase compliance kickoff — NovaCare procurement packet

Hi David,

Thanks for taking the time today. As we discussed on the call, Procurement at NovaCare needs a short evidence bundle before we can move forward to PO issuance for the pilot (NB-4531). Our security team has a narrow checklist they require up front:

- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) or a summary attestation
- ISO 27001 scope statement or snapshot
- Penetration test letter or executive summary (last 12 months)
- Data retention/backup policy and a contact for security questionnaires

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide the items above in the next 48 hours? If not, a prioritized list of what you can share and estimated delivery times will be fine. We need the delivered packet to route to our Vendor Risk team by next Tuesday to keep the September pilot schedule.

Appreciate it — copying Procurement for visibility.

Best,
Julia Sanders
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
NovaCare Health

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear checklist and the call earlier. Short answers below and plan: 

- SOC 2 Type II: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report summary (we redact customer lists). Neha will attach the summary and the auditor contact.
- ISO 27001: we maintain an ISO snapshot (scope + certificate image).
- Pen test: We have a pen test executive summary and a signed letter from the testing vendor (redacted CVEs removed).
- Data retention: we will include our retention policy and a designated security contact.

Plan: I will send the evidence bundle as three attachments by Monday morning (PST). If Procurement needs fully unredacted artifacts or an NDA/secure transfer channel, let us know; we can arrange SFTP or secure Drive link.

Marissa — looping you in for PO/finance readiness once Procurement confirms acceptance of the evidence packet.

Thanks,

Thanks Neha — that packet looks sufficient for our initial vendor risk assessment. A couple quick asks: 

1) Please confirm the SOC 2 period covered (dates) and whether the auditor signed the report.
2) For the pen test letter: can you confirm whether remediation trackers exist for high/critical findings (we understand redactions).
3) Send a secure link for any unredacted items; Procurement will generate an NDA if necessary.

If we can get those confirmations this week, I will route to Vendor Risk and aim to have PO issued (net-45) by next Wednesday. Would you prefer we send the PO to Marissa (marissa.cole@redwood.com) or to contracts@redwood.com?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Julia
